text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(One, and, two, 
three, and, four, and—)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
—The final step simply will not land 
cleanly. 
Perhaps... I should treat it as a form and 
pour my spirit into it.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
—Did I let loose too much bloodlust? 
...Forgive me, little birds.
